svg.title: Duet's verified 54-case coding and disclosure results
svg.desc: Mean counted per-case hidden-test scores: Duet hybrid 89.26%, same frontier with boundary disabled 96.54%. Hybrid had 0 planted-value matches in 1,124 captured requests, versus 35,809 in 1,328 passthrough requests. All 54 outcomes count, including one external failure scored zero. There are 53 native grader records; no fresh quality judges ran.
